cost.lane_active_field: raw[0xc2c] (close-latched lane state, never capture-time busy)
cost.lane_active_note: raw[0xc2c] lane_active is only updated while the cost session is active and is frozen at the closing edge; it is a close-latched lane state, reported as information only, and a natural carry-out legitimately latches the A lane
cost.sampling_phase_note: samples are taken every 16th eligible A copy, so the sampler observes one fixed phase of the copy cadence; per-sample and grouped statistics describe only that sampled phase and are never extrapolated to the whole A population
cost.repetition_note: three runs per condition are engineering repetition: no p-value, no novelty claim and no full-method decision
cost.zero_sample_note: zero or small sample counts are legitimate and are not errors
fullstats_notes: 全量统计覆盖共同窗口内全部合格 A 搬运；旧每 16 次抽样只覆盖一个固定相位，二者只按相同 req/miss 组比较均值与范围。
抽样与全量都只给出均值与范围；没有原始全量记录就不宣称总体中位数，也不推断分位数。
组 0..4 的键为 requests=4 且 IOTLB miss=g（g=0..4）；组 5 是其他组合，只列实际计数、总和与范围，不给它虚构固定的 req/miss 键。
req 记录 select 事件，miss 记录 IOTLB 查找未命中，两者分别计数，不是完整 DDT/PDT/PTW 类型加权基线；本段统计不是缓解方法 M 的收益。
